# repository. It is kept because links into the old repository name old hashes -- seven
# released versions' GitHub Releases, changelog entries and PyPI project page are full of
# them -- and this file is how such a permalink is resolved to the commit here. The old

# they are resolvable in the archived old repository through the LEFT-hand column alone.
